verdict.rationale: OpenHands' own CLI gives a rich, interactive experience with instant feedback and lets you pause a running agent. Agent Canvas is described as a control center for agent conversations, and the agent-server goals feature lets a UI show progress with stop/resume controls, so live observation of a running agent is supported. However, no evidence explicitly describes a live activity stream or a current-status indicator. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of real-time action/event streaming to the user, a documented current-status display (e.g., running/idle/waiting), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Type natural language tasks and receive instant feedback
Agent Canvas is the open-source browser client and control center for agent conversations and automations.
